description:
About Judi Health 

 Judi Health is a health technology company providing benefit administration solutions to employers, unions, health plans, and government entities. Judi Health replaces fragmented, outdated systems with the industry's first Unified Claims Processing™ architecture, seamlessly consolidating pharmacy and medical benefit administration on a single, secure platform. By delivering true price transparency, eliminating unnecessary middleman fees, and leveraging advanced AI-powered care delivery, Judi Health helps clients achieve unprecedented operational efficiency and service levels.

At Judi Health, we're deploying the infrastructure our country needs to deliver the healthcare we all deserve. We are the intelligence platform powering benefits plans for millions of Americans and proudly leading the next generation of care. To learn more, visit www.judi.health .

 Location: Hybrid 3 days in office (New York, NY, Denver, CO or Charlotte, NC area)

 About the team 

 The Platform team at Judi Health is made up of passionate, motivated, and driven individuals who are experts in technology and dedicated problem solvers. We operate with a strong sense of ownership and urgency, delivering high-quality solutions that ensure seamless operations and foster collaboration across the engineering organization. The team owns the architecture, standards, infrastructure, and CI/CD pipelines that development teams rely on to deliver code to the Judi® platform. We are also responsible for supporting production environments through monitoring, alerting, and operational best practices, while providing both enterprise-wide solutions and guidance to product teams.

 Position Summary: 

 We are a rapidly growing late-stage health tech company helping millions of lives through our innovative product Judi. We’re seeking a skilled Platform Developer to join our platform team.

 This role will be responsible for supporting and evolving Judi Health’s cloud infrastructure, CI/CD processes, Snowflake platform administration, security initiatives, and infrastructure-as-code practices. The ideal candidate will work across Snowflake, Terraform, GoCD, AWS, Docker, and platform security technologies to ensure secure, reliable, and scalable operations. This position requires strong technical problem-solving skills, a security-first mindset, and the ability to collaborate across multiple engineering and business teams.

 Position Responsibilities: 

 
 Administer and support the Snowflake platform, including access management, role and privilege administration, operational support, and infrastructure-as-code governance using Terraform.

 Maintain and enhance Snowflake-related CI/CD processes, including developing and supporting GoCD pipelines, troubleshooting deployment issues, resolving Terraform failures, and addressing configuration drift.

 Support platform security initiatives by identifying, prioritizing, and remediating vulnerabilities across infrastructure, applications, containerized workloads, and supporting technologies.

 Assist with container and build-related activities from a security perspective, including Docker image maintenance, Amazon ECR publishing, dependency management, and adoption of secure, hardened container images.

 Assist with audit, compliance, and security assessment activities through technical evidence gathering, documentation, and control validation.

 Review infrastructure-as-code and platform-related pull requests to ensure adherence to engineering, security, and operational best practices.

 Develop and maintain automation tools, operational utilities, and platform solutions using Python, Terraform, and related technologies.

 Participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation to provide continuous operational support and rapid incident response.

 
 Required Qualifications 

 
 3+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering, or a related field; alternatively, 3+ years in QA, Automation, Systems Engineering, or a similar technical role with a demonstrated interest in platform engineering and infrastructure automation.

 Experience supporting cloud infrastructure and platform services, including AWS, Terraform, CI/CD platforms (GoCD, GitHub Actions, Harness, Jenkins, or similar), and Infrastructure-as-Code practices.

 
 
 Basic expertise with Linux systems and command-line environments.

 Working knowledge of Snowflake administration, including access management, role-based permissions, security principles, and operational support using SQL.

 Experience with Docker, containerized applications, Git-based development workflows, code review processes, and automation utilizing Python or Bash.

 Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively partner with Engineering, Data, Security, Compliance, and other cross-functional teams.

 Strong experience supporting 24/7 production on-call rotations, including responding to alerts and resolving incidents outside of standard business hours

 
 Preferred Qualifications 

 
 Experience supporting Snowflake environments in a production setting.

 Experience with Rust in either a personal project or professional setting.

 Familiarity with security vulnerability management and remediation processes.

 Experience supporting audit, compliance, and evidence-gathering activities.

 Knowledge of container security, hardened images, CIS benchmarks, or secure software supply chain practices.

 Experience creating or maintaining GoCD pipelines and deployment workflows.

 Experience within healthcare, financial services, or other regulated industries.

 
  
 New York, NY Salary Range
 $108,800 — $136,000 USD 

 Denver, CO Salary Range
 $100,000 — $125,000 USD 

 Charlotte, NC Salary Range
 $92,000 — $113,500 USD 


 All employees are responsible for adherence to the Judi Health Code of Conduct including the reporting of non-compliance. This position description is designed to be flexible, allowing management the opportunity to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities as needed to best meet organizational goals. 

 We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, medical condition, genetic information, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.   

 By submitting an application, you agree to the retention of your personal data for consideration for a future position at Judi Health. More details about Judi Health's privacy practices can be found at   https://www.judi.health/legal/privacy-policy .
